verdict.rationale: Epic's privacy policy explicitly covers Unreal Engine and states that users may have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data collected through Epic Services. That gives a request-based deletion path. Retention, however, is only described as "as long as we reasonably need it," with no user-controllable retention settings. missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods, self-service deletion controls, documentation of what engine/editor data is collected and retained, independent or hands-on corroboration of the deletion process.
